rooms.title: Find Your Serenity
rooms.description: From sunlit mornings with mountain views to cozy evenings spent in comfort, each of our accommodations is a destination in itself.
rooms.standardDescription: To ensure a seamless and comfortable stay, every room and suite is equipped with our signature selection of thoughtful amenities.

roomDescriptions.deluxeGarden: Experience tranquility in our sun-drenched rooms, where large windows frame breathtaking views of our meticulously manicured gardens, creating a serene and picturesque escape.
roomDescriptions.deluxeMountain: Wake up to breathtaking panoramic views of Kalaw's rolling hills and mist-covered peaks from your private balcony, offering a truly immersive highland experience.
roomDescriptions.honeymoonSuite: Celebrate love in our exquisitely designed suite, featuring a private jacuzzi and a romantic ambiance perfect for unforgettable moments and peaceful relaxation.
roomDescriptions.evergreenSuite: Our most prestigious accommodation, offering unparalleled luxury with expansive living spaces, dedicated butler service, and the finest amenities for an elite experience.
roomDescriptions.deluxeTwinGarden: A perfect blend of comfort and style, featuring two premium twin beds and a peaceful view of our lush gardens for a relaxing shared stay.
roomDescriptions.deluxeTwinMountain: Ideally suited for those seeking shared comfort with a view; enjoy the majestic mountain scenery from a room designed for relaxation and premium living.
roomDescriptions.familySuite: Designed with families in mind, this spacious suite provides the perfect balance of privacy and togetherness, ensuring every family member feels right at home.
roomDescriptions.executiveSuite: Tailored for the sophisticated traveler, our executive suite combines functionality with luxury, offering premium amenities and panoramic views of the highland landscape.
